caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with an upholstered seat, backrest, and armrest panels. The upholstery is patterned with various shades of red and features floral or botanical motifs. The wood elements, including the armrests, legs, and cross-bracing, are shown in a brown color and have a gently curved design, particularly on the armrests and legs. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no other objects or decorative elements present, keeping the focus entirely on the chair situated in the center of the composition.
title: Armchair
